note: Majority: 18, read 2026-11-03 on Retsinformation (the Danish State's legal portal) in Lovtidende A: the Anordning nr. 397 of 20 April 2010 puts the guardianship Act (lov nr. 388 of 14 June 1995) in force for the Faroe Islands, from 1 May 2010 (§ 52), in its own wording; § 1: children and young people under eighteen who haven't married are minors and so not of full age (a marriage under eighteen, with the Rigsombudsmand's permission, isn't held). Whether it has been amended since wasn't checked. Until 2026-11-03 the majority stood null: the Faroese guardianship order (BEK nr 453 af 28/04/2010) had been found by name on Retsinformation, which didn't show its text, and logir.fo's search returned only its blank form. Work: no Faroese text on young people's work was read (logir.fo's search, and a web search in Faroese, found none); null. Service: Denmark's Værnepligtsloven (consolidated by LBK nr 225 af 13/03/2006, amended to LOV nr 715 af 20/06/2025, which from 2026 extends the duty to women), § 5: 'the country' in the Act means the Kingdom of Denmark except the Faroe Islands and Greenland; § 13: conscripts resident or staying in the country must attend Forsvarets Dag in the year they turn eighteen; § 1 stk. 3: someone who moves to Denmark from the Faroes or Greenland after living there at least ten years may be exempted. So a person living in the Faroe Islands isn't called (my reading of §§ 5 and 13 together): none.

sources.title: Retsinformation: Bekendtgørelse af værnepligtsloven (LBK nr 225 af 13/03/2006, as amended to LOV nr 715 af 20/06/2025)
sources.said: Den, der er tilflyttet fra Færøerne eller Grønland efter at have haft ophold der i mindst 10 år, kan af forsvarsministeren eller den myndighed, forsvarsministeren bemyndiger til det, fritages for værnepligt. ... Ved udtrykket »landet« forstås i denne lov Kongeriget Danmark med undtagelse af Færøerne og Grønland. ... Værnepligtige, der har bopæl eller ophold her i landet, skal møde til Forsvarets Dag i det år, hvori de fylder 18 år.

sources.title: Anordning nr. 397 af 20. april 2010 om ikrafttræden for Færøerne af værgemålsloven (Lovtidende A, udgivet 21. april 2010), Retsinformation
sources.said: Umyndige under 18 år § 1. Børn og unge under 18 år, der ikke har indgået ægteskab, er mindreårige og dermed umyndige. ... § 52. Anordningen træder i kraft den 1. maj 2010.
